    than one is passed, precedence is community_id > preset > prompt.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description:
List the user's trained models with pre-computed train/test stats.
    `acting_as` names the identity listed: the linked account or a trial user (#1962).

tools.name: list_deployed
tools.description: List the user's currently deployed (live) models.

      features: Plain-English description of features (e.g. "RSI 14, Bollinger Bands").

tools.description:

    by a composite performance score (best first). No signup or key needed.

    Each entry's `id` is what `one_shot` takes as `community_id` to deploy a
    live signal model running that exact strategy.

    Args:
      limit:

tools.description:
Find a published community strategy that matches a plain-English idea.

    Mirrors the quantifyme.ai landing page: "Found <X> by @<author> (WR/PF):
    use it, or generate fresh". It is for browsing; a vague deploy request is
    handled by one_shot(prompt=...) alone, which deploys the best curated

tools.description:

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description:
Get the latest price of a market: a quick "what's it at now" check.

    Useful for context before deploying a strategy. The price is the close of
    the most recent 1-minute bar from the platform's market feed (not a raw
    live tick); FX markets close on weekends, so the `stale` flag marks a bar

tools.name: get_model_chart
tools.description:
A trained model's backtest: trades, stats and the data for a cumulative-return chart.

    Takes a model's `stem` (from `get_deploy_result`, `one_shot` or `list_models`)
    and returns how it traded. In clients that render the openai/outputTemplate
    widget (ChatGPT) it shows an interactive chart

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "link_account" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Link this chat to the user's existing QuantifyMe account. For a user who already has a QuantifyMe account, who wonders why their models are missing here, or who…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: one_shot, link_account, get_quote · Private data: get_deploy_result · Public sink: one_shot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: one_shot, link_account, get_quote · Private data: get_deploy_result · Public sink: one_shot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
